values: Let users search indexed copies of your app's products, documents or other records.

overview.label: Strengths
values: Hosted search APIs, interface libraries and tools for tuning result relevance.
Typo-tolerant search, filters and autocomplete with managed Typesense infrastructure.
Flexible text queries, analysis and connected tools for large search projects.
OpenSearch queries and analysis with AWS network and access integrations.

overview.label: Limitations
values: Plan-specific limits and features; you still send records and build the search experience.
Searchable fields consume memory; size capacity and enable high availability when needed.
More query and data-model choices to learn; Hosted and Serverless features differ.
You still size the domain, design indexes and plan major upgrades.

responsibilities.label: Hosted search service
responsibilities.explanation: The provider operates the search infrastructure. A search index is an organized copy of content for fast matching and ranking, not a replacement for your primary database or a search interface automatically added to your app.

responsibilities.label: Private search results
responsibilities.explanation: Search must respect the same record permissions as the original app. Protect administrative keys and enforce user-specific filters or server-side checks. Hiding a result in the interface does not prevent someone from querying an exposed index.
